verdict.rationale: Asana exposes a full RESTful API with JSON responses, official JS/Python client libraries, OpenAPI specs, webhooks, and a developer sandbox — all of which allow the product to be driven headlessly (e.g., from scripts or CI pipelines) without any UI interaction. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples or guides, rate-limit/quota guidance for automated bulk usage, and independent hands-on reports of running Asana automation in a CI context.
